name: QQ
description: 腾讯出品的即时通讯软件，聊天、传文件和群组。
intro: QQ 是腾讯推出的即时通讯软件，支持文字、语音、视频聊天，文件传输、群组和远程协助。新版 QQ 采用 NT 架构，界面更清爽，适合日常沟通和传大文件。

en.name: QQ
en.description: Tencent's messaging app for chat, file transfer and groups.
en.intro: QQ is Tencent's messaging app with text, voice and video chat, file transfer, groups and remote assistance. The NT-based version has a cleaner interface and is handy for daily chat and sending large files.

name: UU远程
description: 网易出品的远程控制工具，低延迟远程桌面。
intro: UU 远程是网易推出的远程控制软件，支持远程桌面、文件传输和手机控制电脑，连接稳定、延迟低，适合远程办公和帮家人处理电脑问题。

en.name: UU Remote
en.description: NetEase remote desktop tool with low latency.
en.intro: UU Remote is NetEase's remote control app with remote desktop, file transfer and phone-to-PC control. It is stable and low-latency, useful for remote work or helping family with their computers.

name: UU加速器
description: 网易出品的游戏加速器，降低外服游戏延迟。
intro: 网易 UU 加速器是一款游戏网络加速工具，支持上千款国内外游戏，通过专线节点降低延迟、减少丢包，适合玩外服游戏的玩家。需要登录网易账号使用。

en.name: UU Accelerator
en.description: NetEase game accelerator that lowers ping for overseas games.
en.intro: NetEase UU Accelerator is a game network booster supporting hundreds of games. It uses dedicated routes to reduce ping and packet loss, and requires a NetEase account.

name: 雷神加速器
description: 游戏加速器，支持外服游戏和主机加速。
intro: 雷神加速器是一款游戏网络加速工具，支持 PC、主机和手游加速，提供多条专线节点，适合玩外服网游和联机游戏的玩家。

en.name: Leigod Accelerator
en.description: Game accelerator for PC, console and mobile games.
en.intro: Leigod Accelerator boosts PC, console and mobile games with multiple dedicated routes, aimed at players of overseas online and co-op games.

name: 迅游加速器
description: 老牌游戏加速器，支持国内外网游加速。
intro: 迅游加速器是国内较早的游戏加速工具，支持上千款网游加速，提供智能节点选择，适合玩外服游戏的玩家。

en.name: Xunyou Accelerator
en.description: Long-running game accelerator for domestic and overseas games.
en.intro: Xunyou Accelerator is one of the earliest Chinese game boosters, covering hundreds of online games with smart node selection.

name: 奇游加速器
description: 游戏加速器，支持 PC 和主机游戏加速。
intro: 奇游加速器是一款游戏网络加速工具，支持 PC、主机和手游，提供专线节点和智能加速，适合外服游戏玩家。

en.name: Qiyou Accelerator
en.description: Game accelerator for PC and console games.
en.intro: Qiyou Accelerator supports PC, console and mobile games with dedicated routes and smart acceleration for overseas game players.

name: KOOK
description: 语音开黑工具，游戏玩家常用的语音频道。
intro: KOOK 是一款语音沟通工具，提供语音频道、文字聊天和屏幕共享，常被游戏玩家用来开黑和组队，支持 Windows、手机和网页端。

en.name: KOOK
en.description: Voice chat app popular with gamers for team play.
en.intro: KOOK is a voice communication app with voice channels, text chat and screen sharing, widely used by gamers to team up. It runs on Windows, mobile and the web.

name: MobaXterm
description: 强大的 SSH/X11 终端工具，集成 SFTP 和远程桌面。
intro: MobaXterm 是一款面向开发者和运维的终端工具，集成 SSH、SFTP、X11 转发、串口和远程桌面，支持多标签和会话管理，适合管理 Linux 服务器。

en.name: MobaXterm
en.description: Powerful SSH/X11 terminal with built-in SFTP and remote desktop.
en.intro: MobaXterm is a terminal toolbox for developers and sysadmins, bundling SSH, SFTP, X11 forwarding, serial and remote desktop with tabs and session management.
